class.name: pendulum_pd_control/PendulumPDController
class.description: Host-side PD controller for a single revolute joint driven in CST mode. Reads position and velocity; writes effort. Supports gravity, inertia and viscous feedforward; FREE / TUNE / PD modes via std_srvs/Trigger services.

class.name: pendulum_pd_control/DriveStatusBroadcaster
class.description: Broadcaster for myActuator drive telemetry (temps, bus voltage, encoder, filtered velocity/torque, position demand, following error). Claims a configurable set of state interfaces, republishes each as std_msgs/Float64 and bundles them into one thresholded diagnostic_msgs/DiagnosticArray.
